note: Hand-set heuristic weights. Each signal maps a feature to a 0-1 suspicion with a linear ramp: 'high' means larger values are more bot-like (ramp [no_concern, full_concern]); 'low' means smaller values are more bot-like. These are not learned or calibrated.

signals.bot: The account is very new ({value} days old).
signals.human: The account has existed for {value} days.

signals.bot: The profile is mostly empty ({pct} complete).
signals.human: The profile is filled in ({pct} complete).

signals.bot: No custom profile picture.
The username ends in a long number ({value} digits), a common auto-generated pattern.
signals.human: The username does not look auto-generated.

signals.bot: The username contains a random-looking letter sequence.
The bio contains promotional language or links.

signals.human: The platform reports the account as verified.

signals.bot: Very high posting volume ({value} posts per day).
signals.human: Posting volume is ordinary ({value} per day).

signals.bot: Posts arrive at unusually even intervals (variation {value}).
signals.human: Posting times are irregular, as is typical for people.

signals.bot: {pct} of gaps between posts repeat the same interval (scheduled posting).
Activity continues around the clock (quietest 6 hours still hold {pct} of posts).
signals.human: There is a clear daily rest period.

signals.bot: {pct} of posts follow the previous one within 10 seconds.
Activity in the last week is {value}x the earlier rate.
{pct} of activity is reposts or shares rather than original posts.
{pct} of posts are near-identical to another post.
signals.human: Posts are varied rather than copies of each other.

signals.bot: {pct} of posts repeat earlier posts word for word.
Heavy hashtag use ({value} per post).
Most posts carry links ({value} per post).
{pct} of links point to the same website.
Very repetitive vocabulary (diversity {value}).
{pct} of posts use spam-like language (payment, urgency, promotion).
Follows {value}x more accounts than follow it back.
signals.human: Follower and following counts are balanced.

signals.bot: Very low engagement relative to the audience size.
Engagement is suspiciously uniform across posts (variation {value}).
Followers jumped by up to {pct} in a single day.
